slides.heading: DEPTH LAYERS
slides.subheading: Always build at least three layers in your frame.

slides.heading: WHY IT MATTERS
bullets: Depth layers create dimensionality—they matter because flat images feel cheap and lifeless.
Foreground adds texture, midground holds the subject, background sets context.
Move your camera, not just your zoom, to build layers.

slides.heading: THREE LAYERS
slides.caption: Foreground, midground, and background separate your subject from a flat frame.

slides.heading: HOW TO BUILD LAYERS
steps: Place your subject in the midground.

slides.heading: PRO TIP
slides.text: Foreground blur instantly adds production value.

slides.heading: COMMON MISTAKE
slides.text: Shooting everything from eye level with no layers.
